Receiver missing on your phone or Mac?
• Connect both devices to the same local network. Wi-Fi and Ethernet can work together.
• Avoid guest networks and client isolation on your router.
• Check whether the sender VPN or firewall allows local network access.
• Discovery uses multicast/mDNS. Keep automatic recovery enabled when switching networks.
The app cannot check the sender network until it connects. Different networks are one possible cause.

Picture cropped? Calibrate the four corners. The TV can crop the HDMI image even when the app sends the whole frame.
SRT/VTT subtitles: use CC during URL video playback. Screen mirroring uses subtitles from the sender.
